pages.title: Halloween Witch Riding a Broom Across the Full Moon Above a Sleeping Village Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch rides her broom across the full moon in this printable coloring page, with a flowing cape above a village of cottages. Clouds and stars frame her pointed hat, while striped stockings and buckled shoes add small sections. The coloring sheet combines broad moon and clothing areas with village windows and trees.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Stirring a Bubbling Cauldron Inside Her Stone Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch stirring a bubbling cauldron inside her stone cottage, surrounded by potion bottles, hanging herbs, and a candle. Her long dress and the round pot provide open coloring areas. Smaller sections in the laced bodice, window panes, and leafy plants fill out the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Cuddling a Black Cat on Her Cottage Steps Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch cuddles her black cat on the cottage steps in this printable coloring page, beside a broom, pumpkin, and hanging wall lantern. The cat sits on her lap with closed eyes and a curled tail. Broad dress folds contrast with boot laces, stonework, and leaves on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Reading a Spellbook at a Candlelit Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch reading a spellbook at a candlelit desk, with a cat watching beside the moon-and-star book cover. Stacked books, a potion bottle, and bundled herbs cover the tabletop. The coloring sheet leaves wide areas in her hat and sleeves, alongside smaller leaves and decorative book corners.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Carving a Jack-o'-lantern at a Wooden Table Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch carves a jack-o'-lantern at a wooden table in this printable coloring page, with pumpkin pieces and scattered seeds around her hands. The large pumpkin has triangular eyes and a wide toothy smile. Its rounded sections and the witch's hat offer broad spaces, while the scraps add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Giving Candy to a Trick-or-treating Child at Her Front Door Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch giving candy to a trick-or-treating child at her front door, holding a bowl of wrapped sweets. The child wears a pumpkin costume and carries a matching candy bucket. A porch lantern and doormat frame the scene, with broad clothing areas and small candy wrappers on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Carrying a Pumpkin Candy Bucket Along a Decorated Village Street Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch carries a pumpkin candy bucket along a decorated village street in this printable coloring page, wearing a bow-trimmed hat and striped stockings. Jack-o'-lanterns stand beside the houses, and triangular bunting crosses overhead. The coloring sheet includes broad cape and skirt sections with smaller cobblestones, flowers, and wrapped candies.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Casting a Star-shaped Spell with Her Wand in a Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Halloween witch casting a star-shaped spell with her raised wand in a castle courtyard, surrounded by swirling sparkles. Pointed towers and crenellated walls rise behind her flowing dress. Large clothing panels provide open areas on the coloring sheet, while the stars, buckles, and paving stones add finer sections.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Gazing Into a Crystal Ball in Her Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch gazes into a crystal ball in her tower in this printable coloring page, with a cat beside her and books stacked nearby. The ball rests on a crescent-decorated stand beneath her hovering hands. An arched window reveals a distant castle, adding stonework and small architectural details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Choosing a Pumpkin in an Autumn Pumpkin Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch choosing a pumpkin in an autumn pumpkin patch, bending beside a large pumpkin among curling vines. A fence and rounded bushes form the background. Broad pumpkin segments and dress panels share the coloring sheet with smaller leaves, tendrils, boot laces, and hat buckle details.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Pouring a Potion Into a Glass Bottle at Her Workbench Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch pours a potion into a glass bottle at her workbench in this printable coloring page, with bubbles visible in both round vessels. Books, loose leaves, and a bowl of herbs surround the bottle she steadies. The coloring sheet offers broad hat and sleeve areas alongside smaller bubbles, leaf veins, and bottle openings.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Gathering Mushrooms Beneath a Twisted Forest Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch gathering mushrooms beneath a twisted forest tree, reaching toward a spotted cap while holding a filled basket. Grass and exposed roots surround the mushroom cluster. The woven basket, hat buckle, and tree bark create smaller sections on the coloring sheet beside the broad dress and mushroom caps.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Planting Magical Herbs in Her Cottage Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch plants magical herbs in her cottage garden in this printable coloring page, kneeling with a trowel while a cat watches nearby. A basket of leafy sprigs sits beside the garden bed. The coloring sheet combines open dress and hat shapes with smaller leaves, basket weaving, and ivy climbing the cottage wall.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Unlocking the Iron Gate of a Haunted Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch unlocking the iron gate of a haunted mansion, holding a large key in one hand and her broom in the other. Curled gate ornaments frame the distant towers and winding path. Wide dress panels contrast with narrow iron bars, stone blocks, and mansion windows throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Carrying a Lantern Along a Moonlit Graveyard Path Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch carries a lantern along a moonlit graveyard path in this printable coloring page, passing headstones and bare trees beneath a full moon. A candle is visible inside the lantern she holds. The coloring sheet has open areas in her dress and the sky, with small grass tufts, pebbles, and buckles below.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Greeting a Friendly Ghost Beside a Hollow Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch greeting a friendly ghost beside a hollow tree, raising her hand while the ghost spreads its arms. She holds a broom and wears striped stockings with curled-toe boots. The coloring sheet leaves the ghost and dress largely open, while tree-bark lines and grass add smaller details.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Letting an Owl Perch on Her Gloved Forearm Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch lets an owl perch on her gloved forearm in this printable coloring page, with a pumpkin and picket fence behind her. The owl faces her with large round eyes and layered wing feathers. Broad sections in the long dress, cape, and moon balance the smaller feathers and clothing buckles on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Watching Bats Fly Out of a Ruined Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Halloween witch watching bats fly out of a ruined tower, holding a tall spiral-topped staff beneath the full moon. Broken stone walls and fallen blocks surround the tower opening. Small wing panels and masonry sections fill the coloring sheet beside wider areas of the witch's hat, cape, and dress.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Sitting Beside a Pond with a Frog on a Lily Pad Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch sits beside a pond with a frog on a lily pad in this printable coloring page, resting her chin on one hand. The spotted frog faces her across water edged with rocks and reeds. This coloring sheet has broad water and clothing spaces, with smaller frog toes, grass blades, and rippling lines.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Opening an Old Chest of Magical Charms in Her Attic Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch opening an old chest of magical charms in her attic, lifting a crescent pendant while a cat watches. Star charms, bottles, crystals, and a round decorated object fill the chest. Roof beams, plank flooring, and metal chest bands divide the coloring sheet into varied sections.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Making a Broom From Twigs Outside Her Garden Shed Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch makes a broom from twigs outside her garden shed in this printable coloring page, tying the bundle while seated beside her cat. Loose branches and a coil of rope lie at her feet. Numerous narrow twig sections fill the lower coloring sheet, while her dress, hat, and shed door provide larger spaces.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Sweeping Autumn Leaves From Her Cottage Porch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch sweeping autumn leaves from her cottage porch, with pumpkins and a pot of flowers beside the door. She angles the broom toward a leafy pile on the planks. The coloring sheet includes broad dress panels and smaller leaf points, broom bindings, flower petals, and lantern panes.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Teaching a Young Apprentice to Read a Spellbook in a Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch teaches a young apprentice to read a spellbook in this printable coloring page, pointing to illustrated pages inside a classroom with shelves. Moons, stars, leaves, and a potion bottle decorate the open book. The coloring sheet includes two pointed hats, flowing sleeves, stacked books, a candle, and a cauldron drawn on the board.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Writing a Spell on a Parchment Scroll Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch writing a spell on a parchment scroll with a feather quill, accompanied by a cat and candle. The unfurled parchment leaves a broad blank area between its curled ends. Books, a round potion bottle, the quill's barbs, and the cat's fur add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Selecting a Spellbook From a Tall Library Shelf Using a Ladder Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch selects a spellbook from a tall library shelf in this printable coloring page, climbing a ladder while a cat watches from below. The chosen book has a crescent moon and stars on its cover. Rows of book spines create narrow sections throughout the coloring sheet, balanced by the witch's broad dress and hat.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Decorating Her Pointed Hat with a Ribbon at a Dressing Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch decorating her pointed hat with a ribbon at a dressing table, seated beside an oval standing mirror. A ribbon spool, flower vase, and small round box sit on the tabletop. Long skirt panels and the mirror offer open areas, while bows, petals, and boot laces add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Fastening Her Buckled Boots Beside a Cottage Coat Rack Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch fastens her buckled boots beside a cottage coat rack in this printable coloring page, seated on a bench with one knee raised. A spare pointed hat and cloak hang behind her, with a broom alongside them. The oval rug adds curved bands to the coloring sheet beneath broad clothing shapes and small buckle details.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Wearing a Patchwork Cloak Beside a Harvest Scarecrow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch wearing a patchwork cloak beside a harvest scarecrow, surrounded by pumpkins, curling vines, and a wooden fence. Both figures have stitched patches, and the scarecrow wears a checked shirt with overalls. The coloring sheet includes broad cloak panels alongside small stitches, straw ends, and clothing checks.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Baking Pumpkin-shaped Cookies in Her Cottage Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch bakes pumpkin-shaped cookies in her cottage kitchen in this printable coloring page, pressing a cutter into dough while her cat looks on. A tray of cookies, mixing bowl, and whole pumpkin fill the counter. The coloring sheet adds small herb bundles, window panes, and checked cloth sections around the larger dough and clothing areas.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Serving Tea From a Pumpkin Teapot Beside Her Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Halloween witch serving tea from a pumpkin teapot beside her fireplace, with cookies on a table and a sleeping cat. A stream of tea flows into the cup she holds. Broad chair and dress sections share the coloring sheet with teacup rims, cookie dots, fireplace stones, and a carved pumpkin on the mantel.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Hanging Bat-shaped Decorations Above Her Cottage Window Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch hangs bat-shaped decorations above her cottage window in this printable coloring page, standing on a stool while a cat watches from below. The three bats hang along a curved cord over a flower box. Pumpkins, stonework, leaves, and petals provide smaller coloring sections around the witch's wide skirt and hat on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Levitating a Chair with Her Wand in Her Sitting Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch levitating a chair with her wand in her sitting room, with swirls and stars surrounding the floating furniture. She stands on an oval rug beside a fireplace and potted plant. The chair's slats and rug fringe add narrow sections to the coloring sheet alongside broad dress panels and wall space.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Crossing a Crooked Wooden Bridge Over a Forest Stream Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch crosses a crooked wooden bridge over a forest stream in this printable coloring page, carrying a spiral-topped staff between the rope rails. Uneven planks stretch above water and rounded rocks. The coloring sheet combines wide dress and hat spaces with smaller wood-grain lines, rope bindings, bushes, and grass along the banks.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Opening the Round Door of a Mushroom Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch opening the round door of a mushroom cottage, turning toward the doorway beneath a large spotted cap. A small round window and pumpkins flank the entrance, with stepping stones leading toward it. The coloring sheet offers broad mushroom and skirt areas, plus door hinges, curved gills, and leafy plants.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Consulting a Star Chart Beside a Telescope in Her Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch consults a star chart beside a telescope in her tower in this printable coloring page, with a cat and books near her. The chart displays stars joined by lines within circular guides. A crescent moon appears beyond the arched window, while telescope fittings and small star shapes add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Holding a Crescent-moon Staff on a Castle Balcony Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Halloween witch holding a crescent-moon staff on a castle balcony, with distant towers beneath stars and a crescent moon. Her other hand rests on the curved stone railing. The flowing dress creates large sections on the coloring sheet, contrasted by the staff's twisted shaft, faceted ornaments, and narrow architectural details.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Discovering a Tiny Dragon Asleep Beside Her Cauldron Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch discovers a tiny dragon asleep beside her cauldron in this printable coloring page, kneeling to touch its spotted back between its small wings. The dragon's tail curls across the stone floor beside a closed book. Broad cauldron and clothing areas balance the smaller horns, claws, wing panels, and curled tail on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Choosing a Potion Bottle in an Apothecary Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch choosing a potion bottle in an apothecary shop, examining a round vessel decorated with a moon and stars. Shelves hold differently shaped bottles with leaf, heart, and sun motifs. A cat watches near her boots, while hanging herbs and small bottle decorations add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Offering Enchanted Candy Apples at a Halloween Market Stall Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch offers enchanted candy apples at a Halloween market stall in this printable coloring page, displaying two treats decorated with stars and moons. More apples fill a round tray beneath the canopy, with hanging jack-o'-lanterns overhead. The coloring sheet combines large apple coatings and clothing areas with small decorations, pumpkin grooves, and wooden stall details.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Dancing Beside a Cauldron Under a Starry Sky Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch dancing beside a cauldron under a starry sky, raising her arms as her skirt swings outward. Bubbles and curling steam rise from the round pot beneath the full moon. Striped stockings, small stars, clothing buckles, and stones add separate coloring areas around the broad dress and cauldron on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Following a Trail of Floating Candles Through an Enchanted Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch follows a trail of floating candles through an enchanted forest in this printable coloring page, walking with her cat and lantern-topped staff. Sparkles surround the candles above the winding path, with castle towers in the distance. Leaves, pebbles, boot laces, and candle drips provide smaller details around the broad clothing areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Peering Into a Wishing Well with Her Broom Resting Nearby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Halloween witch peering into a wishing well, resting both hands on the stone rim with her broom leaning nearby. A bucket hangs from the rope beneath the well's pitched roof. Individual stones and roof tiles divide the coloring sheet into sections, alongside broad dress panels and narrow broom bristles.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Turning a Magical Hourglass on a Tower Windowsill Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch turns a magical hourglass on a tower windowsill in this printable coloring page, with sand trickling between its bulbs beneath her hands. The decorated frame stands before an arched window overlooking a distant castle. Large dress and cape sections share the coloring sheet with small diamond ornaments, twisted supports, and stone blocks.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Showing a Bubbling Potion to a Curious Goblin Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch presenting a bubbling potion to a curious goblin, holding the round bottle high beside her tall staff. The goblin clasps its hands and looks upward, wearing ragged clothes and wrapped leggings. Bubbles, pointed ears, pouch straps, and rope belts add small details around the broad clothing areas of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Listening to a Raven Perched on a Crooked Signpost Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch listens to a raven perched on a crooked signpost in this printable coloring page, resting one hand against her cheek beside her staff. The raven has an open beak above two blank wooden direction signs. Broad dress and sign areas leave open spaces, while feathers, wood grain, and grass add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Looking Into a Magic Mirror Framed with Curling Vines Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween witch looking into a magic mirror framed with curling vines, touching its surface while holding a spiral-topped staff. Her reflection repeats the pumpkin ornament on her pointed hat and the laced bodice. The coloring sheet offers broad dress sections surrounded by narrow leaves, curled frame details, and boot laces.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Following Tiny Footprints Through a Moonlit Corn Maze Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch follows tiny footprints through a moonlit corn maze in this printable coloring page, pointing down at the trail while carrying her staff. Tall corn stalks line both sides of the winding path beneath the full moon. Kernel rows and long leaves create small sections around the larger hat, cape, and dress areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Drawing a Magic Circle on a Stone Floor with Chalk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Halloween witch drawing a magic circle on a stone floor with chalk, kneeling beside a pumpkin and candle lantern. Crescent moons, diamond sparkles, and a central star fill the ringed design. The coloring sheet includes broad hat and dress areas, with smaller symbols, floor stones, and ivy around a nearby column.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Enchanting an Apple Beside a Crooked Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween witch enchants an apple beside a crooked cottage in this printable coloring page, pointing her wand toward the fruit balanced above her palm. Sparkles surround the apple, while a stepping-stone path winds past the fenced cottage. The coloring sheet includes large dress panels and smaller boot laces, roof tiles, leaves, and pumpkin segments.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Greeting a Friendly Skeleton Beside an Old Gravestone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch greeting a friendly skeleton beside an old gravestone, with both figures waving and the witch holding her broom. The cracked headstone stands between them near a bare tree. Broad dress and hat areas contrast with the skeleton's individual ribs, fingers, toes, and joints on the coloring sheet.
